scripts.format: prettier --write 'frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx}' && docker compose run --rm backend uv run ruff format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check 'frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx}' && docker compose run --rm backend uv run ruff format --check && docker compose run --rm backend uv run ruff check
scripts.lint: docker compose run --rm backend uv run ruff check
scripts.typecheck: docker compose run --rm backend uv run pyright
scripts.test:backend: docker compose run --rm backend uv run pytest
